data.name: Samu
data.gender_notes: Samu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who protects or is a deity. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sama’ meaning ‘equal’ or ‘protect’ and the suffix ‘u’ indicating a male or a god. The name Samu carries the meaning “Protector, God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Samu usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine protector, remover of obstacles and bestower of blessings. Can be used as a name for a child born under the auspicious influence of the Sun or Fire element.
data.etymology: Samu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Samu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

Hindu mythology is filled with such divine beings and gods known as ‘Samaswami’ or protectors, who came to the aid of people in need.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Samu" carries deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘sama,’ which means ‘equal’ or ‘protect.’ In the religious context, it represents the divine protection offered by the gods to their devotees, symbolizing the constant presence of a higher power. The name Samu serves as a reminder that no matter the challenges life presents, one can always seek solace and guidance from the divine forces within and beyond.
